controls.title: Organizational Size Scope (Portée relative à la taille de l'organisation)
controls.statement: Organizations using the baseline controls should have less than 499 employees.

controls.title: In-Scope Information Systems and Risk Acceptance (Systèmes d'information visés et acceptation des risques)
controls.statement: Organizations should list which parts of their information systems and assets are in scope for their implementation of the baseline controls and should provide the rationale for excluding information systems and assets and recognize the acceptance of risk in doing so.

controls.title: Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability Injury Assessment (Évaluation des préjudices à la confidentialité, à l'intégrité et à la disponibilité)
controls.statement: Organizations should assess the potential injury to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability to their information systems and assets.

controls.title: Primary Cyber Threat Identification (Identification de la menace cybernétique principale)
controls.statement: Organizations should self-identify their primary cyber threat.

groups.title: Develop an Incident Response Plan (Élaborer un plan d'intervention en cas d'incident)

controls.title: Severity-Based Incident Response Planning (Planification de l'intervention selon la gravité de l'incident)
controls.statement: Organizations should have a basic plan for how to respond to incidents of varying severity. If an organization is unable to manage some types of incidents on its own, the organization should have a plan for what it will do.

controls.title: Written Incident Response Responsibilities and Hard-Copy Availability (Plan écrit des responsabilités d'intervention et copie papier)
controls.statement: Organizations should have a written incident response plan that details who is responsible for handling incidents, including any relevant contact information for communicating to external parties, stakeholders, and regulators. Organizations should have an up-to-date hard copy version of this plan available for situations where soft copies are not available.

controls.title: Cyber Security Insurance Coverage Evaluation (Évaluation de la couverture d'assurance cybersécurité)
controls.statement: Organizations should consider purchasing a cyber security insurance policy that includes coverage for incident response and recovery activities OR provide a rationale for not purchasing one.

groups.title: Automatically Patch Operating Systems and Applications (Appliquer automatiquement les correctifs)

controls.title: Automatic Software and Hardware Patching (Application automatique des correctifs logiciels et matériels)
controls.statement: Organizations should enable automatic patching for all software and hardware OR establish full vulnerability and patch management solutions.

controls.title: Legacy Device Replacement Risk Assessment and Manual Update Process (Évaluation des risques liés aux appareils sans mise à jour automatique)
controls.statement: Organizations should conduct risk assessment activities as to whether to replace any software and hardware that are not capable of automatic updates. If the organization chooses to keep such devices, they should have a business process to ensure regular manual updates.

groups.title: Enable Security Software (Activer les logiciels de sécurité)

controls.title: Automatic Anti-Malware Updates and Scanning (Mises à jour et analyses automatiques des logiciels anti-malveillants)
controls.statement: Organizations should enable anti-malware solutions that update and scan automatically.

controls.title: Host Software Firewalls Activation (Activation des pare-feu logiciels sur les appareils)
controls.statement: Organizations should activate any software firewalls included on the devices that are within organizational networks OR document the alternative measures in place instead of these firewalls.

groups.title: Securely Configure Devices (Configurer les appareils de façon sécuritaire)

controls.title: Secure Device Configuration and Default Credential Removal (Configuration sécuritaire des appareils et retrait des mots de passe par défaut)
controls.statement: Organizations should implement secure configurations for all their devices, changing all default passwords, turning off unnecessary features, and enabling all relevant security features.

groups.title: Strong User Authentication (Authentification forte des utilisateurs)

controls.title: Two-Factor Authentication Enforcement (Application de l'authentification à deux facteurs)
controls.statement: Organizations should implement two-factor authentication wherever possible, and document all instances where they make the business decision not to do so. Organizations should require two-factor authentication for important accounts such as financial accounts, system administrators, cloud administration, privileged users, and senior executives.

controls.title: Compromise-Driven Password Rotation (Changement de mot de passe uniquement en cas de compromission)
controls.statement: Organizations should only enforce password changes on suspicion or evidence of compromise.

controls.title: Password Length, Reuse, and Password Manager Policy (Politique sur la longueur, la réutilisation et les gestionnaires de mots de passe)
controls.statement: Organizations should have clear policies on password length and reuse, the use of password managers and if, when, and how users can physically write down and securely store a password.

groups.title: Employee Awareness Training (Sensibilisation et formation des employés)

controls.title: Employee Cyber Security Awareness and Training Program (Programme de sensibilisation et de formation en cybersécurité)
controls.statement: Organizations should invest in cyber security awareness and training for their employees.

groups.title: Backup and Encrypt Data (Sauvegarder et chiffrer les données)

controls.title: Essential Business System Backup and Offsite Recovery Verification (Sauvegarde des systèmes essentiels et vérification de la restauration)
controls.statement: Organizations should back up systems that contain essential business information, and ensure that recovery mechanisms effectively and efficiently restore these systems from back-ups. Organizations should consider storing back-ups offline at a secure offsite location OR provide the rationale for not doing so.

controls.title: Encrypted Backup Storage and Access Restriction (Chiffrement des sauvegardes et restriction d'accès)
controls.statement: Organizations should securely store back-ups in an encrypted state, and restrict access to them to those who must access them for the testing or use of restoration activities. Long term backups (e.g. weekly backups) must be stored offline, but frequent backups (e.g. daily backups) may be stored online.

controls.title: Mobile Device Ownership Model and Risk Documentation (Modèle de propriété des appareils mobiles et documentation des risques)
controls.statement: Organizations should decide on an ownership model for mobile devices and document the rationale and associated risks.

controls.title: Work and Personal Data Separation on Mobile Devices (Séparation des données professionnelles et personnelles sur les appareils mobiles)
controls.statement: Organizations should enforce separation between work and personal data on mobile devices with access to corporate IT resources, and document the details of this separation.

controls.title: Trusted Mobile Application Sources (Sources fiables d'applications mobiles)
controls.statement: Organizations should ensure that employees only download mobile device apps from the organization’s list of trusted sources.

controls.title: Mobile Device Sensitive Information Encryption (Chiffrement des renseignements sensibles sur les appareils mobiles)
controls.statement: Organizations should require that all mobile devices store all sensitive information in a secure, encrypted state.

controls.title: Enterprise Mobility Management Evaluation (Évaluation d'une solution de gestion de la mobilité d'entreprise)
controls.statement: Organizations should consider implementing an enterprise mobility management solution for all mobile devices OR document the risks assumed to the audit, management, and security functionality of mobile devices by not implementing such a solution.

controls.title: Wireless Connectivity Restrictions for Mobile Devices (Restrictions relatives aux connexions sans fil des appareils mobiles)
controls.statement: Organizations should enforce or educate users to (1) disable automatic connections to open networks, (2) avoid connecting to unknown Wi-Fi networks, (3) limit the use of Bluetooth and NFC for the exchange of sensitive information, and (4) use corporate Wi-Fi or cellular data network connectivity rather than public Wi-Fi.

controls.title: VPN Usage on Public Wi-Fi Networks (Utilisation d'un RPV sur les réseaux Wi-Fi publics)
controls.statement: Organizations should consider using a VPN if they require connectivity to public Wi-Fi networks OR provide the rationale for not using a VPN.

groups.title: Establish Basic Perimeter Defences (Établir des défenses de périmètre de base)

controls.title: Network Boundary Firewalls and DMZ Server Isolation (Pare-feu de périmètre réseau et isolation des serveurs accessibles par Internet)
controls.statement: Organizations should have dedicated firewalls at the boundaries between its corporate network and the Internet. The organization should isolate Internet-facing servers from the rest of their corporate network.

controls.title: Outbound DNS Firewall Implementation (Mise en œuvre d'un pare-feu DNS sortant)
controls.statement: Organizations should implement a DNS firewall for outbound DNS requests to the Internet.

controls.title: Secure Remote Access with VPN and Two-Factor Authentication (Accès à distance sécurisé par RPV et authentification à deux facteurs)
controls.statement: Organizations should require secure connectivity to all corporate IT resources, and require VPN connectivity with two-factor authentication for all remote access into corporate networks.

controls.title: Secure Corporate Wi-Fi Authentication (Authentification Wi-Fi d'entreprise sécurisée WPA2-Enterprise)
controls.statement: Organizations should only use secure Wi-Fi, preferably WPA2-Enterprise.

controls.title: Public and Corporate Wi-Fi Network Segregation (Séparation des réseaux Wi-Fi publics et d'entreprise)
controls.statement: Organizations should never connect public Wi-Fi networks to their corporate networks.

controls.title: Point-of-Sale System Isolation and PCI DSS Alignment (Isolation des systèmes de point de vente et conformité PCI DSS)
controls.statement: Organizations should isolate point-of-sale systems from the Internet and other areas of the corporate network with a firewall. Organizations should consider following the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS).

controls.title: DMARC Email Authentication Implementation (Mise en œuvre du protocole DMARC pour les services de courriel)
controls.statement: Organizations should ensure the implementation of DMARC on all of the organization’s email services.

controls.title: Ingress and Egress Email Filtering (Filtrage des courriels aux points d'entrée et de sortie)
controls.statement: Organizations should implement email filtering at points of ingress and egress.

groups.title: Secure Cloud and Outsourced IT Services (Sécuriser les services infonuagiques et TI impartis)

controls.title: Cloud Service Provider SOC 3 Trust Services Attestation (Attestation SOC 3 SSAE 18 des fournisseurs de services infonuagiques)
controls.statement: Organizations should require that all their cloud service providers share an AICPA SSAE 18 SOC 3 report that states that they achieved Trust Service Principles compliance.

controls.title: Outsourced IT Provider Sensitive Information Handling Evaluation (Évaluation du traitement des renseignements sensibles par les fournisseurs TI impartis)
controls.statement: Organizations should evaluate their comfort level with how their outsourced IT providers handle and access their sensitive information.

controls.title: Data Residency and Legal Jurisdiction Assessment (Évaluation des juridictions légales d'hébergement des données)
controls.statement: Organizations should evaluate their comfort level with the legal jurisdictions where their outsourced providers store or use their sensitive information.

controls.title: Encrypted Communication with Cloud Services (Communications chiffrées avec les services et applications infonuagiques)
controls.statement: Organizations should ensure that their IT infrastructure and users communicate securely with all cloud services and applications.

controls.title: Separate Cloud Administrative Accounts with Two-Factor Authentication (Comptes administrateurs infonuagiques distincts avec authentification à deux facteurs)
controls.statement: Organizations should ensure that administrative accounts for cloud services use two-factor authentication and differ from internal administrator accounts.

controls.title: OWASP Top 10 Web Vulnerability Mitigation (Atténuation des 10 principales vulnérabilités Web de l'OWASP)
controls.statement: Organizations should ensure that their websites address the OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities.

controls.title: OWASP ASVS Verification Level Determination (Détermination du niveau de vérification de sécurité des applications ASVS)
controls.statement: Organizations should ensure that they understand the ASVS level they need to meet for each of their websites.

groups.title: Implement Access Control and Authorization (Mettre en œuvre le contrôle d'accès)

controls.title: Least Privilege Account Provisioning and Admin Restriction (Attribution des privilèges minimaux et restriction des droits d'administrateur)
controls.statement: Organizations should provision accounts with the minimum functionality necessary for tasks and in particular should restrict administrator privileges to an as-required basis.

controls.title: Dedicated Administrative Account Usage (Utilisation dédiée des comptes d'administrateur)
controls.statement: Organizations should only permit administrator accounts to perform administrative activities (and not user-level activities such as accessing email or browsing the web).

controls.title: Timely Account and Privilege Revocation (Révocation rapide des comptes et des privilèges inutilisés)
controls.statement: Organizations should remove accounts and/or functionality when employees no longer require these for their tasks.

controls.title: Centralized Authorization Control System Evaluation (Évaluation d'un système centralisé de contrôle des autorisations)
controls.statement: Organizations should consider implementing a centralized authorization control system OR provide a rationale for not implementing a centralized authorization control system.

groups.title: Secure Portable Media (Sécuriser les supports amovibles)

controls.title: Organization-Owned Encrypted Portable Media Mandate (Utilisation obligatoire de supports amovibles chiffrés appartenant à l'organisation)
controls.statement: Organizations should mandate the sole use of organization-owned secure portable media, have strong asset controls for these devices, and require the use of encryption on all of these devices.

controls.title: Portable Media Sanitization and Destruction Prior to Disposal (Nettoyage ou destruction des supports amovibles avant leur mise au rebut)
controls.statement: Organizations should have processes for the sanitization or destruction of portable media prior to disposal.
